title: bharatsim_code
summary: A small collection of scripts for generating synthetic population data (synthpop-generation) for what appears to be an agent-based epidemic simulation project in India, including job assignment for simulated individuals. The code imports CTGANSynthesizer directly from the standalone ctgan package to train and sample synthetic job-label data.
